how_to_apply: BMC accepts applications only through the online mode, via the Gujarat OJAS portal. A separate application (and separate fee) is required for each post/advertisement.
Click "More Details" to review the full advertisement, then click "Apply Now"
Select the relevant post (Executive Engineer-Civil / Sanitary Sub Inspector / MPHW-Male, Urban Malaria) to view its vacancy details, then click "Apply Now" again to open the Application Format
Fill in Personal Details (mobile number and email ID are mandatory for correspondence), Educational Details, Additional Qualification, and Experience Details
Complete the Additional Information section and the Self-Declaration (Yes/No), then click "Save" to generate your Application Number
Use "Edit Application" to make any corrections before confirming - no changes are possible after confirmation
Upload Photo (5 cm height x 3.6 cm width) and Signature (2.5 cm height x 7.5 cm width) in .jpg format, each under 15 KB
Preview the application, then click "Confirm Application" to generate the Confirmation Number - the application is not valid without this step
Click "Print Challan," print the fee challan, and pay the applicable fee at a nearby post office by 17 September 2026
Retain the confirmed application printout and the paid fee challan; submit these (with enclosures) by Registered Post/Speed Post or in person at the BMC office only if and when BMC calls for them

content_sections.heading: BMC Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: BMC has advertised a combined 80 vacancies across the three posts covered in this recruitment cycle. The category-wise breakup for each post is given in parentheses in the table below. Additionally, 10% of posts in each category are reserved for Ex-servicemen, and 4% for candidates with physical disabilities (Persons with Disabilities), as per the respective notifications. Within the Sanitary Sub Inspector post, 1 of the 4 posts is earmarked for PwBD (Low Vision); within the MPHW post, 3 of the 75 posts are earmarked for PwBD (across Low Vision; Deaf/Hard of Hearing; and locomotor/other specified disabilities). The Commissioner, Bhavnagar Municipal Corporation, reserves the unrestricted right to change the number of vacancies shown above.

content_sections.heading: BMC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is the same across all three posts and must be paid at a post office (with computer facility) using the printed challan generated after submitting the online application. Reserved-category candidates from states other than Gujarat, who are not entitled to reservation benefits in Gujarat, must pay the fee applicable to the Unreserved category. The fee must be paid by 17 September 2026 (as per the Executive Engineer and Sanitary Sub Inspector notifications); the fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances, and applications without fee payment will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: BMC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The base upper age limit differs by post; existing BMC employees are exempt from the upper age limit itself, but subject to an overall maximum of 58 years in all cases. Age relaxation in the upper age limit, applicable to candidates who are original domicile of Gujarat and belong to reserved categories (including EWS) and to women/disabled candidates, is common across all three posts: General category women: 5 years Reserved category men: 5 years Reserved category women: 10 years General category disabled men: 5 years General category disabled women: 10 years Reserved category disabled men: 10 years Reserved category disabled women: 15 years Ex-servicemen are entitled to age relaxation as per applicable Government rules. In all cases, the age including all applicable relaxations must not exceed 45 years on the closing date of application. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: BMC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for all three posts is through a Written Examination and/or Oral Test (Interview), as decided by the BMC Selection Committee, based on the number of applications received. The BMC Selection Committee will decide the appropriate cut-off percentage based on the number of vacancies and applications received, and prepare a merit list; only shortlisted candidates will be issued a call letter for the written exam and/or oral test The medium of the written exam will be decided by BMC based on the post's core educational discipline, or Gujarati by default (English-medium for English-subject questions) For the Executive Engineer (Civil) post, if both a written exam and oral test are held, the final merit list will weight the written exam at 90% and the oral test at 10% For the Sanitary Sub Inspector and MPHW posts, the final merit list will be based on 100% of the result of the written exam/oral test, as conducted For the MPHW post specifically, candidates with National/International, Inter-University, or All India School-level representation in specified sports (athletics, badminton, basketball, cricket, football, hockey, swimming, table tennis, volleyball, tennis, weightlifting, wrestling, boxing, cycling, gymnastics, judo, rifle shooting, kabaddi, kho-kho, archery, horse riding, shot put, boat racing, chess, and handball) are eligible for a 5% bonus on marks obtained in the first-stage competitive written exam, subject to producing the prescribed certificate Widowed candidates (for all three posts) get 5% additional marks in the written exam under prevailing Government provisions, subject to conditions specified in the notification regarding remarriage status Candidates already in service with BMC or another Government/semi-Government body, if selected, must resign from their existing post before joining; their prior service period will not be regularised or counted The provisional merit list/select list remains valid for 2 years, or until the result of the next such examination is declared, whichever is earlier The Commissioner, Bhavnagar Municipal Corporation's decision on interpretation of the notification and the recruitment process is final and binding on all candidates

faq.question: Q1. What is BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BMC Recruitment 2026 is a direct recruitment drive by Bhavnagar Municipal Corporation to fill 80 posts across three cadres — Executive Engineer (Civil), Sanitary Sub Inspector, and Multi Purpose Health Worker (Male) (Urban Malaria).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A combined total of 80 vacancies: 1 for Executive Engineer (Civil), 4 for Sanitary Sub Inspector, and 75 for Multi Purpose Health Worker (Male) (Urban Malaria).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For Executive Engineer (Civil) and MPHW (Male, Urban Malaria), the last date is 15 September 2026 (23:59 hrs).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification differs by post: B.E./B.Tech (Civil) with relevant experience for Executive Engineer; a Graduate degree plus a Sanitary Inspector diploma for Sanitary Sub Inspector; and an MPHW or Sanitary Inspector diploma for Multi Purpose Health Worker.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 18 to 35 years for Executive Engineer (Civil) and Sanitary Sub Inspector, and 18 to 33 years for Multi Purpose Health Worker (Male), with age relaxation of 5 to 15 years for reserved/women/disabled candidates, subject to an overall cap of 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹1,000/- for Unreserved category candidates and ₹500/- for Reserved category candidates, payable at a post office using the OJAS-generated challan.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online at http://ojas.gujarat.gov.in by selecting the relevant post, filling in personal, educational, and experience details, uploading photo/signature, confirming the application, and paying the fee at a post office.
